title: First recording with a brass band
summary: His only recording was with a brass band, apparently with George Lewis, made with little rehearsal.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Who was the first person you ever made a record for? When was that?
I didn't make no record until I made one with a brass band down there.

They didn't have much of a bass on them. The fellas just jumped up and made them records, you know? They didn't practice. The bass player, he didn't have no amateur.
